rows.title: Customer Insight Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Why This Role Matters 

This is a pivotal role supporting our O+O (Offline & Online) strategy, to deliver exceptional customer experiences. As a Customer Insights Analyst, you will help create trusted performance visibility, enable data-led decision-making, improve access to actionable insights and drive the adoption of self-service analytics across the business. Working with stakeholders across multiple functions, you will transform complex data into clear, meaningful insights that help teams make smarter decisions with confidence. Our goal is to create clarity from complexity, enabling stronger performance and sustainable growth that shapes how millions of customers experience our brands so we can put a smile on our customers' faces today and tomorrow.

What You'll Be Doing

Use customer, loyalty and transactional data to uncover the behaviours, needs and motivations that influence how customers shop across our O+O (Offline & Online) channels. Transform complex customer and market data into clear, actionable insights that help teams make better decisions and drive business performance. Partner with teams across Customer, Commercial, Marketing and Trading to identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty and retention. Monitor customer trends, market developments and competitor activity to identify emerging opportunities and help shape future strategies. Deliver meaningful analysis and recommendations that support the creation of more relevant, personalised and seamless customer experiences across our brands. Explore and apply new analytical techniques, technologies and AI capabilities to uncover growth opportunities, predict future trends and enhance decision-making. Champion a customer-first mindset, using insight and evidence to influence priorities, challenge thinking and help teams better understand our customers. 

What You'll Bring

Strong experience in customer, behavioural and market analytics, with the ability to identify customer trends, uncover growth opportunities and generate meaningful commercial insight. Confident storyteller who can communicate customer and market insights in a compelling way, influencing stakeholders and driving action through data-led narratives. Advanced SQL and analytical skills, with experience transforming complex datasets into clear, actionable recommendations that drive business performance. Strong understanding of customer acquisition, loyalty, customer lifetime value (CLV), member participation and the wider O+O (Offline & Online) retail landscape. Experience delivering customer segmentation, behavioural analysis and customer value insights that have informed commercial strategy and improved customer outcomes. Proven ability to build trusted relationships across functions, translating insight into recommendations that influence business decisions and align to strategic priorities. Hands-on experience using tools such as GA4, SQL and Business Intelligence platforms to deliver scalable analysis and present findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

How You Will Make An Impact

Put the customer at the heart of every insight, helping to shape experiences that are more relevant, seamless and rewarding across both our O+O (Offline & Online) channels. Turn complex data into clear priorities and actionable recommendations that drive meaningful improvements in customer loyalty, retention and long-term value. Spot emerging customer trends, behaviours and market opportunities, using insight to influence future strategies and unlock new areas for growth. Build strong relationships across the business, partnering with stakeholders to ensure customer intelligence is embedded into key decisions and strategic priorities. Bring confidence and curiosity to solving complex challenges, navigating ambiguity and identifying creative solutions that deliver measurable business impact. Champion a customer-first, insight-led culture by helping teams better understand customer needs and make smarter decisions with confidence. Continuously explore new technologies, analytical approaches and AI capabilities that enhance our understanding of customers and create opportunities for future growth. 

Who We Are

You may not have heard of us, but you’ll know our brands! AS Watson is the world’s largest international health and beauty retailer, with over 17,000 stores across 31 markets serving over 5.3 billion customers each year.

From Superdrug, Kruidvat and Watsons to Marionnaud, The Perfume Shop and many more, our brands are loved by customers around the world. Behind them are passionate people who are encouraged to innovate, collaborate and grow.

What You Will Get From Us

Competitive Salary and Bonus Scheme Exclusive Discounts - Enjoy savings across our iconic brands. Holiday entitlementHybrid Working ModelRefer-a-friend schemeLearning and Development Opportunities - Grow your skills with tailored programmes. Mental Health and Wellbeing SupportLife AssuranceInterest Free Loans

rows.title: Software Engineer Intern (Fall 2026)
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

London, UK


About The Role

Anytime we push code, it automatically affects the millions of Internet properties (powering websites, remote teams, APIs, mobile apps, etc.) running on our global network. Cloudflare's network is one of the largest in the world and spans over 330 cities in more than 125 countries. What's more, Cloudflare operates within 50 milliseconds of 95% of the Internet-connected population globally (for context, the blink of an eye is 300-400 milliseconds!). We are passionate about making the Internet more secure, reliable, and faster for everyone.

Cloudflare’s Engineering teams build and run the software that handles the massive amount of traffic that flows through our network. We also have teams that build the UI and control plane for our software, using modern patterns and libraries in a microservices-based architecture. Technologies include: Typescript/Javascript, Go, Rust, C/C++ and Python.

The ideal intern is passionate about making the Internet a better place. You will work alongside experienced engineers. You will push code this internship that touches hundreds of millions of web surfers. We like to get things done, so we are looking for interns who are curious, proactive, and able to complete projects. This is a great opportunity for engineers who want to learn to develop at Internet scale.

You can check out our internship blogs to learn more about our program and hear directly from our past interns.

Responsibilities

Ship and deliver projects over 12-14 weeks with autonomy and support.Work cross-functionally with various teams.Work closely with a mentor to guide you through the internship and help with career goals.Build your network across the company through our various in and out of office socials, networking programs, Employee Resource Group (ERG) programs, and Activity Groups.Present your project to the entire company at the end of the internship.Connect and learn from our executives and leadership team including our co-founders.Learn and develop skills through our professional development workshops.Write for our Cloudflare blog and be featured on Cloudflare.tv sessions. 


Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience

Currently pursuing a degree or program in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or relevant field to the role.Demonstrated critical thinking skills and drive to learn and adapt new technologies.Curiosity, empathy and ability to get things done.Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/a week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship.Our available terms are September 14 - December 4 or September 28 - December 18.In office 3-5 days a week in London, UK.


Bonus Points

Demonstrated passion for software development, such as personal projects, open-source contributions, or experience with our developer platform using Cloudflare for Students.

Please note

We will be hiring interns on a rolling basis until all roles are filled.


What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

rows.title: Associate Customer Success Manager | Maritime SaaS
rows.descriptionText:
About the CompanyAt Spinergie, we aim to help develop Smart solutions for a sustainable and efficient maritime industry. We offer cutting-edge SaaS solutions that empower businesses to optimize operations and reduce their carbon footprint. We leverage data and advanced algorithms to convert complex maritime information into actionable solutions that protect our oceans and drive industry progress.

About the RoleWe are looking for a motivated Associate Client Success Manager (CSM) to join our London office. This is an entry-level role and a great way to kick-start a career in Client Success — no prior CS or maritime experience is required. You'll work closely with our more senior CSMs and the Head of Client Success, learning the ropes while owning real client relationships from day one.

ResponsibilitiesOwn client relationships: you will be the link between Spinergie and your portfolio clients, managing and maintaining relationships at scale.Analyse client objectives: Lead kick-off and onboarding sessions with application owners to align on goals, success metrics, and key use cases. Support the rollout of tailored (and templated) training programmes to help clients achieve their desired outcomes.Drive client engagement: Act as the primary point of contact for users across your portfolio, delivering trainings and resolving inquiries with support from analysts and more senior CSMs. Maintain regular check-ins with application owners to maximise system adoption, track value delivery, and ensure overall client satisfaction.Support revenue retention and renewals: Help manage the renewal process for your portfolio, ensuring churn rates meet and exceed company targets, with guidance from senior CSMs on more complex accounts.Identify growth opportunities: work closely with the Sales team to flag upsell and expansion opportunities within your book of business.Cross-team collaboration: share client insights and feedback with Sales, Product, Tech, and Marketing teams to help steer acquisition and engagement efforts.Technical support: act as a first point of contact for technical questions and issues raised by clients, troubleshooting where possible and looping in Tech/Product teams when needed.Learn and grow: follow and contribute to CS processes, work closely with senior CSMs and the Head of Client Success to build your CS skillset, with a view to growing into a broader portfolio and more strategic accounts over time.

QualificationsThis is an entry-level position (0 to 2 years of experience) — we're not expecting prior Client Success or maritime industry experience.
Required SkillsAny exposure to a client-facing role (internship, placement, customer support, retail, or similar) is a plus, but not required.Prior exposure to the Maritime, offshore, or energy industry, SaaS, or both is a plus, but not required.Rigorous, structured and with a strong sense of prioritization — important given the volume of accounts you'll manage.A reliable and accountable personality.Strong willingness to learn about the offshore and maritime industry.Interest in technical topics, comfortable troubleshooting and learning new tools.Data savvy, comfortable working with data and spotting trends.Listening skills to frame client needs, developing business acumen and a growth mindset.Fluent in English.Strong interpersonal skills and a good team spirit.Based in, or willing to work from, our London office at Waterhouse Square. This role requires regular travel to meet clients and attend industry events across Europe and the Middle East. Candidates must be comfortable with frequent trips and flexible in adapting their schedule to business needs.Ability to work in the UK.
No candidate perfectly meets all the requirements. If this role excites you and you believe you can bring value to our team, we encourage you to apply!We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities.

Hiring processDiscovery: An introductory interview with a member of the CSM team to learn more about Spinergie and the role, and for you to share your experience and motivation.CSM Discussion: An video call with the Head of Customer Success to deep-dive into your past experiences.Collaboration: An interview with a member of the Sales team.Culture Fit: A final meeting with Alice, the Head of People, focused on motivation and culture fit.

rows.title: Paid Founder-in-Residence: Build an Industrial AI Startup
rows.descriptionText:
The Flywheel Venture Studio (www.theflywheel.studio) is recruiting exceptional operators, engineers, and domain experts to build category-defining companies that solve hard problems in Europe’s most critical sectors: Manufacturing, Defence and Energy.
We are looking for ambitious entrepreneurs with first-hand insights into industrial challenges, bottlenecks, and revenue blockers. We turn your insight into a formidable company. You keep up to 80% equity of the company we build together. 
We compress the 0 to 1 journey from years down to months. Accelerators, VCs, and incubators fund you and advise you. We build with you: validating the idea, shipping the first prototype, forming the founding team, incorporating, and winning your first customers and investors. 
As a Founder-in-Residence (FiR), you will be paid while validating, designing, and launching a new venture with hands-on support from experienced founders, operators, engineers, and industry partners. Successful residents receive up to €300k in committed capital at incorporation, and keep up to 80% of their equity. 
The studio’s 20+ investors, including former operators from Google, Boeing and NASA stand ready to make warm introductions to first buyers, pilots, and investors.
We run a paid, hybrid founder-in-residence program out of Thessaloniki, Greece with deep access to one of Europe's largest untapped pools of engineering talent. Successful ventures are free to build anywhere in Europe. 
The RoleAs a Founder-in-Residence, you will work closely with The Flywheel team to identify, validate, and build a venture that uses AI to accelerate productivity and efficiency in one of our core domains:Manufacturing & Supply ChainsDefence & SecurityEnergy & Sustainability
You will operate as the future CEO or CTO of a company formed during or after the program. This is a highly entrepreneurial role for individuals ready to build a 0–1 company with structured guidance, material support and capital.
ResponsibilitiesDuring the FiR Program (ideally 1-3 months, up to 6 months):Conduct deep user research and problem validation across target industriesGenerate or evaluate multiple venture concepts and select a high-potential directionDevelop early prototypes (with The Flywheel engineering support)Validate customer demand, willingness to pay, and pathway to profitabilityRun experiments, pilots, and market testsBuild early business models, market segmentation & analysis, and GTM strategyDevelop and present the investment case for NewCo creationUpon NewCo Formation:Become CEO or CTO of the new companyUse The Flywheel’s €300k investment to launch the ventureBuild the core founding team with our recruiting supportSecure early customers/pilots with Flywheel’s industry partners Lead further capital raises with support from The Flywheel. Put the customer at the heart of every insight, helping to shape experiences that are more relevant, seamless and rewarding across both our O+O (Offline & Online) channels. rows.title: Product Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Product Analyst

Function: Data

Location: London/ Peterborough

Curious about what’s next?

So are we. Join Compare the Market and help to make financial decision making a breeze for millions.

At Compare the Market, we’re a purpose-driven business powered by tech and AI. We’re building high-performing, results-driven teams with the skills, mindset, and ambition to deliver outcomes at pace. Every role here plays a part in driving our mission forward, and we create an environment where you can bring your authentic self, grow a truly characterful career, and see the direct impact of your work on the lives of our customers.

We’ve carved a meerkat-shaped niche and we’re looking for ambitious, curious thinkers who thrive in a fast-moving, high-impact environment. If you love accountability, embrace challenge, and want to make a real difference, you’ll fit right in.

What You’ll Be Doing

 Analyse customer behaviour and product performance using techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation, and behavioural analytics to identify opportunities and drive improvements  Support Product Managers in understanding customer journeys, user engagement, conversion, and retention, helping to shape product strategy and priorities  Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations  Define and measure product success metrics and KPIs, evaluating the impact of product changes and communicating outcomes to stakeholders  Design, execute, and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, helping to embed a culture of experimentation and evidence-based decision-making  Build and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions, proactively monitoring trends, identifying risks, and surfacing growth opportunities  Partner with Analytics Engineering teams to ensure KPI definitions, business logic, and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable, and trusted  Apply AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, predictive modelling, and automated insight generation, to enhance product understanding and measurement  Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis and customer insight 

What We’re Looking For

You’ll have strong analytical skills and experience working with large datasets to uncover insights that drive better customer and business outcomes. You’ll be highly proficient in SQL and comfortable analysing customer and behavioural data to support product decisions and strategic priorities.

You’ll bring experience with experimentation and A/B testing, alongside a solid understanding of statistical concepts and product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and segmentation. Experience with visualisation tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI is essential, as is the ability to communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

You’ll have an understanding of digital product development and customer experience optimisation, with a curiosity for how emerging technologies, including AI, can improve product measurement, experimentation, and customer understanding. Experience using Python or R for analysis, and familiarity with product analytics platforms such as FullStory, Mixpanel, or Amplitude, would be advantageous.

We’re looking for someone who combines analytical rigour with product curiosity, thrives in collaborative environments, and enjoys helping teams make better decisions through data.

Why Compare the Market?

We’re a business built for pace and performance. Here, you’ll be encouraged to think differently, act boldly, and deliver brilliantly in a culture that values results and rewards progress.

We believe diverse teams make better decisions, and we’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels empowered to grow, contribute, and thrive.

If you’re ready to stretch yourself, raise the bar, and grow with a team that’s serious about performance, innovation, and purpose, we’d love to hear from you.

rows.title: Software Engineer Intern (Fall 2026)
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

London, UK


About The Role

Anytime we push code, it automatically affects the millions of Internet properties (powering websites, remote teams, APIs, mobile apps, etc.) running on our global network. Cloudflare's network is one of the largest in the world and spans over 330 cities in more than 125 countries. What's more, Cloudflare operates within 50 milliseconds of 95% of the Internet-connected population globally (for context, the blink of an eye is 300-400 milliseconds!). We are passionate about making the Internet more secure, reliable, and faster for everyone.

Cloudflare’s Engineering teams build and run the software that handles the massive amount of traffic that flows through our network. We also have teams that build the UI and control plane for our software, using modern patterns and libraries in a microservices-based architecture. Technologies include: Typescript/Javascript, Go, Rust, C/C++ and Python.

The ideal intern is passionate about making the Internet a better place. You will work alongside experienced engineers. You will push code this internship that touches hundreds of millions of web surfers. We like to get things done, so we are looking for interns who are curious, proactive, and able to complete projects. This is a great opportunity for engineers who want to learn to develop at Internet scale.

You can check out our internship blogs to learn more about our program and hear directly from our past interns.

Responsibilities

Ship and deliver projects over 12-14 weeks with autonomy and support.Work cross-functionally with various teams.Work closely with a mentor to guide you through the internship and help with career goals.Build your network across the company through our various in and out of office socials, networking programs, Employee Resource Group (ERG) programs, and Activity Groups.Present your project to the entire company at the end of the internship.Connect and learn from our executives and leadership team including our co-founders.Learn and develop skills through our professional development workshops.Write for our Cloudflare blog and be featured on Cloudflare.tv sessions. 


Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience

Currently pursuing a degree or program in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or relevant field to the role.Demonstrated critical thinking skills and drive to learn and adapt new technologies.Curiosity, empathy and ability to get things done.Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/a week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship.Our available terms are September 14 - December 4 or September 28 - December 18.In office 3-5 days a week in London, UK.


Bonus Points

Demonstrated passion for software development, such as personal projects, open-source contributions, or experience with our developer platform using Cloudflare for Students.

Please note

We will be hiring interns on a rolling basis until all roles are filled.


What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Performance Marketing Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

Search: Experiment with text ads, bidding, and campaign structures on Google, Bing, Baidu, Naver, and other search engines. Adapt to new product features and roll out changes from successful tests.Display: Test, analyze, and optimize campaigns on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and others.Modeling: Analyze the vast amounts of data generated by experiments, develop models we can use for optimization, and build dashboards for account managers.

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

Fresh Graduates are welcome to apply!Bachelor’s Degree or higher from top university in a quantitative subject (computer science, mathematics, engineering, statistics or science or related fields)Ability to communicate fluently in EnglishGood numerical reasoning skillsProficiency in ExcelIntellectual curiosity

It’s Great if you Have:

Exposure to one or more data analysis packages or databases, e.g., SAS, R, SPSS, Python, VBA, SQLExperience in digital marketingAcademic research experience

rows.title: Software Engineer Intern (Fall 2026)
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

London, UK


About The Role

Anytime we push code, it automatically affects the millions of Internet properties (powering websites, remote teams, APIs, mobile apps, etc.) running on our global network. Cloudflare's network is one of the largest in the world and spans over 330 cities in more than 125 countries. What's more, Cloudflare operates within 50 milliseconds of 95% of the Internet-connected population globally (for context, the blink of an eye is 300-400 milliseconds!). We are passionate about making the Internet more secure, reliable, and faster for everyone.

Cloudflare’s Engineering teams build and run the software that handles the massive amount of traffic that flows through our network. We also have teams that build the UI and control plane for our software, using modern patterns and libraries in a microservices-based architecture. Technologies include: Typescript/Javascript, Go, Rust, C/C++ and Python.

The ideal intern is passionate about making the Internet a better place. You will work alongside experienced engineers. You will push code this internship that touches hundreds of millions of web surfers. We like to get things done, so we are looking for interns who are curious, proactive, and able to complete projects. This is a great opportunity for engineers who want to learn to develop at Internet scale.

You can check out our internship blogs to learn more about our program and hear directly from our past interns.

Responsibilities

Ship and deliver projects over 12-14 weeks with autonomy and support.Work cross-functionally with various teams.Work closely with a mentor to guide you through the internship and help with career goals.Build your network across the company through our various in and out of office socials, networking programs, Employee Resource Group (ERG) programs, and Activity Groups.Present your project to the entire company at the end of the internship.Connect and learn from our executives and leadership team including our co-founders.Learn and develop skills through our professional development workshops.Write for our Cloudflare blog and be featured on Cloudflare.tv sessions. 


Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience

Currently pursuing a degree or program in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or relevant field to the role.Demonstrated critical thinking skills and drive to learn and adapt new technologies.Curiosity, empathy and ability to get things done.Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/a week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship.Our available terms are September 14 - December 4 or September 28 - December 18.In office 3-5 days a week in London, UK.


Bonus Points

Demonstrated passion for software development, such as personal projects, open-source contributions, or experience with our developer platform using Cloudflare for Students.

Please note

We will be hiring interns on a rolling basis until all roles are filled.


What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

rows.title: 2027 Marketing Analyst Summer Internship Programme London
rows.descriptionText:
Explore the world of Barclays as a Summer Intern

Spend 10 weeks diving into real projects, gaining hands-on experience, and shaping your future. You’ll receive full support, take on meaningful responsibilities, and build lasting connections—all while discovering what makes our culture unique.

If you're in your penultimate year and ready to grow, learn, and make an impact, this is your opportunity to belong and thrive.

Why the Marketing programme?

Marketing at Barclays is about understanding customers and clients, building trusted brands and driving sustainable growth. As an intern, you'll gain first-hand experience of how Marketing helps shape the experiences of millions of customers, clients and communities while exploring areas such as customer insight, brand, content, digital channels, data and emerging technologies such as AI.

You'll work on meaningful projects, collaborate with colleagues across the bank and develop skills in creativity, problem-solving, analysis and stakeholder engagement. Along the way, you'll grow your network, learn from experienced professionals and discover how Marketing creates customer, commercial and brand impact across consumer, business-to-business and Group environments.

To be considered for this opportunity, you must be in your penultimate year of university. You must be graduating in 2028.

You’ll bring creativity, curiosity, analytical thinking and an interest in how insight and communications shape customer and client engagement.

The location for this role is indicated in the job title, and you will be based at that location. If you are successful in receiving a return offer to our graduate programme, your location will be the same as it was during your internship.

Barclays is unable to offer visa sponsorship for this internship as the role does not currently meet the UK Home Office eligibility requirements for Skilled Worker sponsorship.

To be eligible for this internship programme, you must therefore have the legal right to work on a full-time basis in the UK for the entire duration of the internship programme, from June 2027 to August 2027, without requiring sponsorship from Barclays. Please also note that, during your summer internship, you will be considered for a place on our 2028 graduate programme. As the graduate programme also does not meet the UK Home Office eligibility requirements for Skilled Worker sponsorship, to be eligible for the internship, you will also need to demonstrate that you will have the legal right to work in the UK for the full duration of the graduate programme, from August 2028 to August 2030.

Please be aware that if you are unable to satisfy the right to work requirements for either the internship or the graduate programme at any stage, Barclays reserves the right to withdraw any offer made to you.

Working In London

If you love the buzz of city life, our global HQ is the place to be. Our London hub is in Canary Wharf, at the heart of London’s financial district. Here, you won’t just be perfectly placed to explore the nation’s capital; you’ll be in a place where you can explore the many functions and opportunities of a global financial giant.

It is the policy of Barclays to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law.

The closing date for applications is 25 September 2026. Please note that this vacancy may close ahead of the advertised date due to application volumes, and we therefore recommend submitting your application as early as possible.

Purpose of the role

To participate in the attraction and retention of customers and clients, communicating the benefits of banking with Barclays, working on diverse projects, including branding, advertising, social media, digital marketing, events, sponsorships and sales collateral.

rows.title: Marketing Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Our Role

Reporting to the Analytics Manager, the Analyst will help shape our marketing strategy by delivering impactful customer targeting and campaign evaluations. Working closely with the Analytics & Insights team, you’ll ensure our marketing budget is used effectively targeting the right customers with the right propositions at the right time.

You will evaluate campaigns, tell compelling stories with data, and influence stakeholders to drive business growth. This hands-on role offers the chance to develop technical skills and stakeholder influence in a supportive, fast-moving environment.

What You’ll Be Doing

Using SQL and Alteryx as appropriate to extract and manipulate customer data from Databricks in order to understand customer behaviour and target customers for CRM campaigns Use SQL and Power BI as appropriate to measure the effectiveness of those CRM campaigns, effectively communicating levels in confidence in those results and ongoing campaign recommendations. Own the end-to-end campaign targeting and measurement process, working closely with the CRM team to produce initial audience counts, apply eligibility criteria and suppressions, confirm final volumes, and establish robust test and control groups. Work with CRM team to develop an understanding of which targeting strategies have been the most effective, test and learn to evolve our understanding and share ongoing proactive ideas and suggestions Demonstrate strong stakeholder management by proactively communicating progress, opportunities, risks and changes in audience volumes to stakeholders throughout the campaign lifecycle. Demonstrate strong campaign management expertise. Advise on best practices for end- to- end SLAs and cross functional process, targeting, suppressions, evaluation, and QA. Segment and extract customer data from relational databases for targeting and evaluation. Apply effective QA processes to ensure data accuracy. Collaborate with CRM and Performance Marketing teams to improve personalisation and relevancy. Communicate incremental impact of the CRM campaigns, and ongoing recommendations, to stakeholders. Build strong relationships across Marketing and Digital teams, in particular. Design and interpret A/B tests and control methodologies. Proactively suggest ways to improve efficiency of campaign and measurement processes, automating where possible, decrease risk of error, improve confidence in measurement based recommendations, etc 

The Skills & Experience That You’ll Need

Strong SQL skills for data extraction and analysis. Proven experience in campaign analytics, including targeting and measurement. Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deliver selections and measurement outputs to agreed deadlines. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain requirements, progress and analytical findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Highly numerate with strong analytical skills. 2+ years in marketing analysis or similar role. Proficient in SQL & Excel; Power BI and Alteryx preferred but not essential. Databricks experience preferred but not essential 

What we’ll offer you

At The White Company, we value our employees for always going the extra mile for every one of our customers; we reward this with great benefits and competitive salaries.

Discount -Up to 50% discount and access to regular Sample SalesHoliday - 25 days rising to 28 with length of serviceHoliday Buy – opportunity to buy up to 5 days holidayPension Scheme - enrolled in our Group Personal Pension schemes upon joining the business. 20% Bonus - In addition to our competitive salaries, all our employees are entitled to join a discretionary bonus scheme (based on policy eligibility)Wagestream Money Management app - access to Wagestream gives you power over your pay and supports financial wellbeingContinued Development – We offer structured support from our own in-house Learning and Development HubSalary Sacrifice scheme for Electric vehicles (dependent on grade and meeting policy eligibility)Private Healthcare (based on contract duration)Life AssuranceWhite City House (Soho House Group)Tenants Membership at a discounted rate, offering access to facilities in the House

Additional Benefits

Fruit basket dailyTea and coffee providedWorking from Home - option to work from home on Mondays and FridaysSocial - Christmas party/social events throughout the yearSeasonal Sample SalesVolunteer Day - with a charity of your choiceGreat Location - Close to transport links - over ground Shepherds Bush station /underground White City & Wood Lane stations. Westfield shopping centre with shops restaurants/bars/cinema and gyms. 

Our Equality Diversity and Inclusion statement of commitment 

At The White Company we are committed to creating an inclusive culture that welcomes and celebrates a diversity of backgrounds and identities.

We are working together to ensure our environment is one where people can bring their authentic selves to work, where their contribution is valued, ability enhanced, and perspective appreciated. Where difference is respected, encouraged, and celebrated. Where you can feel you belong.

We are committed to an active Equality Diversity and Inclusion Policy, which starts with our recruitment and selection process.

We'd love you to join us on our journey.

Our Sustainability statement of commitment 

We are committed to building a sustainable legacy that will enable a brighter future for people and our planet.’ We believe this should be reflected in everything we do

rows.title: 2027 Marketing Analyst Summer Internship Programme London
rows.descriptionText:
Explore the world of Barclays as a Summer Intern

Spend 10 weeks diving into real projects, gaining hands-on experience, and shaping your future. You’ll receive full support, take on meaningful responsibilities, and build lasting connections—all while discovering what makes our culture unique.

If you're in your penultimate year and ready to grow, learn, and make an impact, this is your opportunity to belong and thrive.

Why the Marketing programme?

Marketing at Barclays is about understanding customers and clients, building trusted brands and driving sustainable growth. As an intern, you'll gain first-hand experience of how Marketing helps shape the experiences of millions of customers, clients and communities while exploring areas such as customer insight, brand, content, digital channels, data and emerging technologies such as AI.

You'll work on meaningful projects, collaborate with colleagues across the bank and develop skills in creativity, problem-solving, analysis and stakeholder engagement. Along the way, you'll grow your network, learn from experienced professionals and discover how Marketing creates customer, commercial and brand impact across consumer, business-to-business and Group environments.

To be considered for this opportunity, you must be in your penultimate year of university. You must be graduating in 2028.

You’ll bring creativity, curiosity, analytical thinking and an interest in how insight and communications shape customer and client engagement.

The location for this role is indicated in the job title, and you will be based at that location. If you are successful in receiving a return offer to our graduate programme, your location will be the same as it was during your internship.

Barclays is unable to offer visa sponsorship for this internship as the role does not currently meet the UK Home Office eligibility requirements for Skilled Worker sponsorship.

To be eligible for this internship programme, you must therefore have the legal right to work on a full-time basis in the UK for the entire duration of the internship programme, from June 2027 to August 2027, without requiring sponsorship from Barclays. Please also note that, during your summer internship, you will be considered for a place on our 2028 graduate programme. As the graduate programme also does not meet the UK Home Office eligibility requirements for Skilled Worker sponsorship, to be eligible for the internship, you will also need to demonstrate that you will have the legal right to work in the UK for the full duration of the graduate programme, from August 2028 to August 2030.

Please be aware that if you are unable to satisfy the right to work requirements for either the internship or the graduate programme at any stage, Barclays reserves the right to withdraw any offer made to you.

Working In London

If you love the buzz of city life, our global HQ is the place to be. Our London hub is in Canary Wharf, at the heart of London’s financial district. Here, you won’t just be perfectly placed to explore the nation’s capital; you’ll be in a place where you can explore the many functions and opportunities of a global financial giant.

It is the policy of Barclays to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law.

The closing date for applications is 25 September 2026. Please note that this vacancy may close ahead of the advertised date due to application volumes, and we therefore recommend submitting your application as early as possible.

Purpose of the role

To participate in the attraction and retention of customers and clients, communicating the benefits of banking with Barclays, working on diverse projects, including branding, advertising, social media, digital marketing, events, sponsorships and sales collateral.

Accountabilities


Execution of small research projects, research to support strategic decision making, preparation of presentations and reports to communicate research findings, collaboration with senior management to implement research findings for marketing.Collaboration with cross-functional teams to support business initiatives.Participation in training and development programs to enhance skills and knowledge.Identification of opportunities, development of business cases, management of the deployment and launch of new products and services for marketing.Management of client relationships and provision of customer service support to clients and customers, under steadily decreasing supervision, responding to questions about products and services, processing of transactions, and resolution of customer complaints.


Analyst Expectations


To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertiseThorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertiseThey lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.Partner with other functions and business areas.Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

rows.title: Marketing Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Our Role

Reporting to the Analytics Manager, the Analyst will help shape our marketing strategy by delivering impactful customer targeting and campaign evaluations. Working closely with the Analytics & Insights team, you’ll ensure our marketing budget is used effectively targeting the right customers with the right propositions at the right time.

You will evaluate campaigns, tell compelling stories with data, and influence stakeholders to drive business growth. This hands-on role offers the chance to develop technical skills and stakeholder influence in a supportive, fast-moving environment.

What You’ll Be Doing

Using SQL and Alteryx as appropriate to extract and manipulate customer data from Databricks in order to understand customer behaviour and target customers for CRM campaigns Use SQL and Power BI as appropriate to measure the effectiveness of those CRM campaigns, effectively communicating levels in confidence in those results and ongoing campaign recommendations. Own the end-to-end campaign targeting and measurement process, working closely with the CRM team to produce initial audience counts, apply eligibility criteria and suppressions, confirm final volumes, and establish robust test and control groups. Work with CRM team to develop an understanding of which targeting strategies have been the most effective, test and learn to evolve our understanding and share ongoing proactive ideas and suggestions Demonstrate strong stakeholder management by proactively communicating progress, opportunities, risks and changes in audience volumes to stakeholders throughout the campaign lifecycle. Demonstrate strong campaign management expertise. Advise on best practices for end- to- end SLAs and cross functional process, targeting, suppressions, evaluation, and QA. Segment and extract customer data from relational databases for targeting and evaluation. Apply effective QA processes to ensure data accuracy. Collaborate with CRM and Performance Marketing teams to improve personalisation and relevancy. Communicate incremental impact of the CRM campaigns, and ongoing recommendations, to stakeholders. Build strong relationships across Marketing and Digital teams, in particular. Design and interpret A/B tests and control methodologies. Proactively suggest ways to improve efficiency of campaign and measurement processes, automating where possible, decrease risk of error, improve confidence in measurement based recommendations, etc 

The Skills & Experience That You’ll Need

Strong SQL skills for data extraction and analysis. Proven experience in campaign analytics, including targeting and measurement. Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deliver selections and measurement outputs to agreed deadlines. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain requirements, progress and analytical findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Highly numerate with strong analytical skills. 2+ years in marketing analysis or similar role. Proficient in SQL & Excel; Power BI and Alteryx preferred but not essential. Databricks experience preferred but not essential 

What we’ll offer you

At The White Company, we value our employees for always going the extra mile for every one of our customers; we reward this with great benefits and competitive salaries.

Discount -Up to 50% discount and access to regular Sample SalesHoliday - 25 days rising to 28 with length of serviceHoliday Buy – opportunity to buy up to 5 days holidayPension Scheme - enrolled in our Group Personal Pension schemes upon joining the business. 20% Bonus - In addition to our competitive salaries, all our employees are entitled to join a discretionary bonus scheme (based on policy eligibility)Wagestream Money Management app - access to Wagestream gives you power over your pay and supports financial wellbeingContinued Development – We offer structured support from our own in-house Learning and Development HubSalary Sacrifice scheme for Electric vehicles (dependent on grade and meeting policy eligibility)Private Healthcare (based on contract duration)Life AssuranceWhite City House (Soho House Group)Tenants Membership at a discounted rate, offering access to facilities in the House

Additional Benefits

Fruit basket dailyTea and coffee providedWorking from Home - option to work from home on Mondays and FridaysSocial - Christmas party/social events throughout the yearSeasonal Sample SalesVolunteer Day - with a charity of your choiceGreat Location - Close to transport links - over ground Shepherds Bush station /underground White City & Wood Lane stations. Westfield shopping centre with shops restaurants/bars/cinema and gyms. 

Our Equality Diversity and Inclusion statement of commitment 

At The White Company we are committed to creating an inclusive culture that welcomes and celebrates a diversity of backgrounds and identities.

We are working together to ensure our environment is one where people can bring their authentic selves to work, where their contribution is valued, ability enhanced, and perspective appreciated. Where difference is respected, encouraged, and celebrated. Where you can feel you belong.

We are committed to an active Equality Diversity and Inclusion Policy, which starts with our recruitment and selection process.

We'd love you to join us on our journey.

We are committed to building a sustainable legacy that will enable a brighter future for people and our planet.’ We believe this should be reflected in everything we do

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. rows.title: Finance Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Description

Hello, we're Starling. We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way. We're a fully licensed UK bank with the culture and spirit of a fast-moving, disruptive tech company. We're a bank, but better: fairer, easier to use and designed to demystify money for everyone. Starling Bank is powered by Engine, the banking platform we built ourselves and which we are now rolling out to other banks around the world. We employ more than 3,500 people across our London, Southampton, Cardiff and Manchester offices.

We are looking for a graduate Finance Analyst to join the Group Management Reporting team. This entry level accounting role sits within a high performing function, being primarily involved in the month-end close process and helping to support the financial control responsibilities of the Group.

As a graduate role, this position would suit someone who is wanting to take their first steps into the world of Finance. The role provides broad exposure to a variety of work streams with opportunities to progress in your accounting career.

We are looking for a candidate with an analytical mindset, someone who actively seeks to understand processes in depth, is able to ask thoughtful questions, take a proactive approach to delivering tasks, and looks to identify opportunities for process improvement as they arise. Understanding the 'why' not just the 'how' is key to success in this role.

Alongside your day-to-day responsibilities, you will be expected to complete the ACA qualification with study time and full funding provided throughout your training, alongside the requirement for the candidate to commit to significant self-study.

Responsibilities

Please note that the duties below represent examples of potential tasks and projects you may be involved in; actual day-to-day responsibilities may vary depending on business needs:

Completing month end accounting tasks within reporting deadlines (accruals, prepayments, depreciation, etc.)Performing bank reconciliations and balance sheet substantiationsOwning process documentation and completing control testingSupporting with the accounting of contracts with key third party suppliersAssisting managers with finance projects and ad hoc analysisUsing BigQuery/Looker to study data and produce meaningful insightsGenerating KPIs for monthly reporting and drafting commentaryDriving process improvements

Requirements

A graduate with a relevant degree (or vocational equivalent), with demonstrable interest in the banking and fintech sectorCandidate should have 0-1 years of post-graduation Finance related work experienceA can-do attitude, belief in our vision, and a willingness to roll-up your sleeves and get stuck into anything and everythingComfortable working in a hybrid environment and capable of maintaining clear and timely communication with their manager regardless of locationTangible evidence of an underlying drive for a career in Finance Committed to pursuing and completing the ACA accounting qualification Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel is necessary

Benefits

25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)An extra day's holiday for your birthdayAnnual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off16 hours paid volunteering time a yearSalary sacrifice, company enhanced pension schemeLife insurance at 4x your salaryPrivate Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and PelotonGenerous family-friendly policiesPerkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perksAccess to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships

About Us

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can't accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren't sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway.

We're on a mission to radically reshape banking - and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we're proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Starling Bank is an equal opportunity employer, and we're proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Starling Bank are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

By submitting your application, you agree that Starling Bank may collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

rows.title: Graduate Strategic Finance Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Graduate Strategic Finance Analyst - Candidate Requirements


Role profile

We are looking for a high-potential graduate to join the Strategic Finance team in London. The role will provide broad exposure across FP&A, management reporting, financial modelling, data and dashboarding, strategic analysis and potentially M&A, alongside involvement in finance transformation and wider business projects.

Candidate profile

The ideal candidate is unlikely to see themselves purely as a traditional accountant. They should be excited by the opportunity to become a modern strategic finance professional, combining strong financial fundamentals with commercial judgement, data analytics, technology and AI.

They should be motivated by using data to answer business questions, building tools and dashboards that improve decision-making, understanding business performance and contributing to projects that improve how Finance operates.

Requirements


Essential requirements

Strong academic background, ideally a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Mathematics, Data Analytics, Computer Science or another analytical/numerate disciplineA clear desire to build a long-term career in finance, FP&A or strategic/commercial financeCommitment to studying towards the CIMA professional qualification as part of the graduate programmeStrong numerical and analytical capability, with the ability to interpret data and identify the key messages behind the numbersStrong interest in the intersection of finance, data and technologyGood working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and an appetite to develop advanced financial modelling and analytical skillsInterest in developing skills in Power BI, data visualisation and business intelligenceGenuine interest in AI and emerging technologies, particularly how they can be applied to finance, analysis, reporting and process improvementCommercial curiosity and an interest in understanding how businesses operate, make money and make strategic decisionsAbility to communicate analysis clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writingStrong attention to detail while also being able to understand the wider commercial pictureProactive, inquisitive and comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions and learning new systems and conceptsAbility to manage multiple priorities and work across both recurring finance activities and project-based workCollaborative approach and confidence working with colleagues across Finance, Technology and the wider business


Desirable attributes

Previous professional finance experience is not required, but any of the following would be advantageous:
