rows.title: Marketing Technology Specialist

company.name: Banner Life family of companies | life insurance

rows.descriptionText:
Overview

At Banner Life Insurance Company, we lead with heart and ambition. Every day, we transform purpose into progress, guided by our unwavering commitment to be better for our customers, clients, and communities, not just today but long-term as well. Our people are the driving force behind everything we achieve. Their passion, purpose, and pursuit of innovation empower us to deliver cutting-edge solutions that support those we serve, ensuring we are here for you, here for good and striving for better.

We’re a forward-thinking company energized by our work and how we show up for one another. Our culture is built on meaningful impact and genuine enjoyment, because we believe great work and great experiences should go hand in hand.

By offering career development opportunities, comprehensive benefits, and programs that support your wellbeing, we help you thrive personally and professionally. We are here for you, here for good and here for better.

The Marketing Technology Specialist stands at the intersection of marketing and technology, orchestrating seamless integration, optimization, and management of digital marketing tools and platforms. This role is essential for companies aiming to maximize their marketing ROI, streamline campaign operations, and leverage data-driven insights for superior customer engagement. The specialist works collaboratively across marketing, IT, sales, and external vendors, serving as both a technical expert and a strategic advisor.

Responsibilities

Marketing Technology Stack Management:

 Evaluate, implement, and manage marketing technology platforms such as CRMs (Customer Relationship Management platforms), MAPs (Marketing Automation platforms), CMSs (Content Management Systems), DAMs (Digital Asset Management platforms), analytics solutions, and other digital tools.  Monitor technological trends and recommend new solutions to enhance marketing efficiency and effectiveness.  Oversee integration of various marketing tools to ensure seamless data flow and campaign management.  Collaborate with IT to ensure systems are secure, scalable, and compliant with privacy regulations.  Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to document requirements, help resolve basic technical issues, and escalate more complex problems as needed. 

Marketing Operations Support

 Support the execution of marketing campaigns through the configuration and management of digital tools and platforms.  Maintain marketing databases, ensuring data integrity, segmentation, and enrichment for targeted campaigns.  Develop and maintain documentation for system processes, workflows, and best practices.  Train and support marketing staff in technology usage and troubleshooting. 

Data Analysis And Insights

 Configure tracking, analytics, and reporting systems to measure campaign performance and ROI.  Analyze marketing data to identify opportunities for optimization and present findings to stakeholders.  Create dashboards and standardized reports to disseminate actionable insights into the marketing team.  Contribute to A/B testing, attribution modeling, and customer journey mapping initiatives. 

Project Management

 Lead and participate in marketing technology projects, from requirements gathering and vendor selection to implementation and training.  Coordinate cross-functional teams and manage project timelines, budgets, and deliverables.  Ensure that all technology-driven initiatives align with broader marketing and business goals. 

Compliance And Security

 Ensure marketing technology practices comply with privacy laws (such as GDPR, CCPA, TCPA) and organizational policies.  Monitor security vulnerabilities and implement best practices to protect customer data and marketing assets.  Adhere to all internal company policies, procedures, and standards related to technology usage, data governance, security, and marketing operations. 

Continuous Improvement

 Stay up to date with emerging marketing technologies, digital trends, and best practices.  Continuously evaluate and recommend improvements to marketing systems and processes.  Foster a culture of innovation within the marketing team regarding the use of technology.  Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by management to support evolving business and marketing technology needs. 

Qualifications

 Education 

 Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field. 

Experience/Knowledge

 2+ years of experience in a marketing technology, digital marketing, marketing operations, or related role.  Strong understanding of digital marketing concepts, platforms, and data analytics.  Experience with marketing technology tools, such as: CMSs (e.g., Sitefinity is preferred, Contentful, WordPress, Drupal)  Web Analytics (e.g., Google Analytics is preferred, Adobe Analytics)  CRMs (e.g., Salesforce is preferred, Microsoft Dynamics)  DAMs (e.g., Brandfolder is preferred, Bynder)  Project Management platforms (e.g., Jira, Wrike)  MAPs (e.g., HubSpot is preferred, Marketo, Pardot, Eloqua)  Tag Management (e.g., Google Tag Manager)  Proficiency with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and reporting.  Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and APIs is highly desirable.  Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.  Strong written and verbal communication abilities, with the capacity to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences.  Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and adapt to a fast-paced, evolving environment. 
Preferred Skills And Attributes

 Certification in marketing technologies (e.g., HubSpot, Google Analytics, Salesforce) is advantageous.  Experience with Data Privacy regulations and compliance frameworks.  Advanced knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages is a plus.  Demonstrated ability to foster collaboration across marketing, IT, and sales teams.  Strategic mindset with an eye for detail and process improvement.  Creative thinker with the desire to explore and implement new technologies. 

What’s in it for you?

The expected hiring compensation range for this position is $70,600 - $88,300 annually. This is a hybrid opportunity working out of our office in Frederick, Maryland. Required to come onsite 3 days per week.

The total compensation package for this position may include other elements, such as a sign-on bonus, long term incentives, and annual bonuses. This role is eligible to participate in the Annual Incentive Plan. The current target payment for the position is 8% of base salary, modified for corporate and individual performance. Bonuses are pro-rated based on start date. This role has 15 vacation days and 10 sick days that are accrued on a bi-weekly basis. Employees also have 9 paid holidays throughout the calendar year .

We have a competitive compensation and benefits package focused on your overall wellbeing. Employee benefits include health, life, and dental insurance; 401K with company match up to 6% as well as a pension package; generous time off; and wellbeing initiatives throughout the year (we like doing fun stuff). We’re big on professional development and we’ll support and mentor you in your career progression and expect you to help us pay it forward by helping us develop tomorrow's leaders and growth-focused professionals. We value our teams and our communities and believe in giving back. Enjoy time off to volunteer for those causes that matter most to you!

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. The Company reserves the right to change benefits plans at any time.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

rows.title: Solutions Architect, Physical Security Systems
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Kastle is the nation’s leading provider of Managed Security Services. Our customers depend on us every day and include the who’s who of commercial real estate, distinguished global retail brands, leading commercial enterprises and critical government facilities. We are committed to providing a ‘Wow’ customer experience and we continually invest in the next big ideas to shape and transform our industry. We are proud to say that our people are the industry’s best and we work hard to create a culture that provides a compelling career for talented individuals.

The Senior Solutions Architect (SSA) is a senior, customer-facing technical expert within Kastle's Product organization. The SSA leads technical discovery and solution validation on complex projects — including engagements involving new engineering, third-party products or integrations outside the Kastle product portfolio, or non-standard infrastructure — ensuring that scope is fully defined and technically sound before installation begins. The SSA is available to any project requiring deeper product or engineering expertise in customer-facing settings.

The SSA also develops the discovery standards, tools, and reference designs used across the sales and delivery organization; coaches Sales Engineers in advanced discovery; and partners with Product Management on requirements intake, alpha and beta programs, and roadmap input. The position works closely with sales, the Presales Business Manager, sales engineering, project management, and the Integrations team, and is a key contributor to reducing change orders, rework, and schedule risk on complex installations.

Our success is driven by the combination of advanced technology and talented people. We are proud to be a Certified Great Place to Work®, recognized for a culture that prioritizes both professional excellence and employee well-being. In addition to a great work environment, we provide a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, and generous paid time off. Our offerings also include tuition and training assistance, BrightHorizons lifestyle assistance, life and disability insurance, and wellness programs. For more information on what it's like to work with us, please visit Life at Kastle.

Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Technical Discovery & Solution Validation

Lead technical discovery on complex projects, with emphasis on engagements involving new product engineering, third-party products or integrations outside the Kastle product portfolio, or non-standard network environments.Participate directly in customer discovery and solutioning conversations on qualifying projects, identifying technical risks, gaps, and constraints as solutions are developed.Validate proposed scope for technical accuracy and completeness before contract award, including network architecture, integration requirements, infrastructure conditions, and site constraints.Serve as the technical escalation point for projects that meet Kastle's complex-project criteria — and for any project where deeper product or engineering representation is requested — determining what additional discovery or validation is required.Partner with the Integrations team on projects involving third-party API integrations and SDK partner deployments — leading pre-award feasibility and scoping when a solution requires products or integrations outside the Kastle product portfolio, transferring validated scope at contract award, and codifying proven integration patterns into reference designs for reuse.Verify that customer network and infrastructure requirements — including firewalls, VLAN segmentation, and customer-managed environments — are documented and resolved prior to installation.Support project delivery teams on complex projects through installation and commissioning, ensuring solutions are implemented as designed.

Solution Design

Design integrated electronic security solutions spanning access control, video surveillance, VMS, and intrusion detection for complex projects.Produce solution documentation including layouts, device maps, schematics, and integration diagrams.Evaluate customer legacy systems and define how existing equipment integrates with Kastle offerings.Ensure all designs comply with applicable codes, standards, and customer specifications.

Discovery Standards & Tools

Develop and maintain the standardized discovery toolkit used on complex projects, including discovery checklists, network requirement questionnaires, reference designs, and scoping templates.Continuously improve discovery standards based on field outcomes, recurring issues, and product changes.Define the criteria and process for engaging the SSA on qualifying projects.

Coaching & Enablement

Coach Sales Engineers in advanced discovery techniques, including recognizing technical risk during live customer conversations.Lead post-project technical debriefs and maintain a shared knowledge base of common scoping pitfalls and lessons learned.Develop and deliver technical training on discovery practices, product capabilities, and solution design.

Product Partnership

Partner closely with Product Managers as the field-facing extension of the Product organization, maintaining a working knowledge of the product roadmap and using it to inform solution design and customer conversations.Curate product enhancement requests arising from the field: consolidate needs raised by Sales Engineers, the Integrations team, delivery teams, and customers; identify recurring patterns across sources; and frame them as well-formed requirements — problem, context, impact, and affected customers — ready for Product Management evaluation.Lead alpha and beta programs in the field: identify suitable customer sites, define success criteria with Product Management, oversee field trials of new products and features, and deliver structured findings that inform release readiness.Represent field and customer realities in roadmap discussions, providing input on prioritization, product gaps, and integration needs.Monitor competitive offerings and industry technology trends relevant to complex deployments.

Certifications & Technical Expertise

Maintain current knowledge of industry standards, emerging technologies, and technology partner solutions.Obtain and maintain certifications from key technology partners as required. Certifications are often highly technical in nature.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering, technical design, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.5+ years of experience designing or engineering physical security systems, including complex, multi-system projects.Expert-level knowledge of:Access control, video surveillance, VMS, and intrusion detection systems. IP networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, VLANs and subnetting, firewalls and NAT, DHCP/DNS, and PoE.Enterprise and customer-managed network environments.Proven ability to lead technical discovery with customers and to identify scope risk during live solutioning discussions.Experience developing technical standards, tools, or reference designs for use by others.Experience coaching or mentoring technical staff.Experience supporting the product development lifecycle — such as structuring customer requirements, running field evaluations, or participating in alpha/beta programs — preferred.Ability to read and interpret security and infrastructure drawings, including floor plans, riser diagrams, network topologies, and device schedules.Proficiency with network diagnostic and diagramming tools (e.g., AutoCAD, Visio, Wireshark, IP scanners), and comfort with command-line interfaces for network diagnostics and device configuration.Networking certification (e.g., CompTIA Network+ or Cisco CCNA) a plus.Excellent customer-facing communication and presentation skills.Ability to travel up to 50% within assigned customer regions.
Company Overview

Kastle Systems is the leader in managed security, with a track record of introducing innovative technologies to serve over 460M square feet of real estate globally. Clients span the commercial and multifamily real estate, education, and construction industries and the customers they serve. With delivering a world class customer experience driving everything we do, Kastle’s mission is to be our customers’ best service provider and to make their security the most effective, efficient, and convenient it can be. Kastle's integrated security solution, including access control, video, and remote video monitoring, significantly reduces costs and improves the critically important 24x7 performance for building owners, developers and tenants.

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Kastle, we believe that diversity makes us stronger - at work and in the world. Kastle Systems International, LLC is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or any other basis protected by applicable federal or state laws.

rows.title: Associate - Product Operations, Flights Inventory
rows.descriptionText:
As a Product Operations Associate supporting Flights Inventory, you’ll help support the operational health, quality, and performance of Capital One’s Flights platform. You’ll work closely with Senior Associates within Product Operations, Customer Service, Product, Engineering, Commercial teams, booking providers, and internal stakeholders to help ensure reliable airline inventory, strong bookability, and exceptional customer experiences across Capital One Travel products.

In this role, you’ll assist with day-to-day operational processes across the shopping and booking lifecycle, including monitoring inventory behavior, supplier configuration support, fare mapping assistance, and onboarding activities for new airline and provider integrations. You’ll also contribute to initiatives focused on shopping optimization, inventory quality, and ancillary product support.

You’ll contribute to bug investigations, operational escalations, and operational issues across booking environments while partnering with cross-functional teams to support issue resolution and continuous improvement efforts. This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, detail-oriented, technically curious, data-driven, has a strong bias for action, and excited to grow within a fast-paced travel technology environment.

rows.title: CRM and Email Marketing Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Katten is a full-service law firm with approximately 650 attorneys in locations across the United States and in London and Shanghai. Clients seeking sophisticated, high-value legal services turn to Katten for counsel locally, nationally and internationally. The firm’s core areas of practice include corporate, financial markets and funds, restructuring, intellectual property, litigation, real estate, structured finance and securitization, transactional tax planning, private credit and private wealth. Katten represents public and private companies in numerous industries, as well as a number of government and nonprofit organizations and individuals.
CRM and Email Marketing SpecialistUnder the general direction of the Marketing Technology and Operations Manager, the CRM and Email Marketing Specialist supports Katten’s Salesforce CRM platform and email marketing function. The Specialist builds and deploys email campaigns in Vuture and contributes to email marketing strategy, including audience segmentation, cadence, and performance measurement. The role works closely with the Firm's Digital Marketing Analyst as well as other Marketing team members.
The Specialist supports attorney and staff users and works on Salesforce configuration, process automation, reporting, documentation, and general system troubleshooting. The Specialist actively participates in discovery sessions, helping to translate business needs into scalable platform solutions. The Specialist also ensures that CRM data standards are followed to keep the Firm's database accurate and trustworthy. The role requires clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences and strict confidentiality in all client and Firm matters.
This position can be located in the Chicago, Washington D.C. or New York office. Katten offers a hybrid work model, allowing the flexibility to work both on-site and remotely on a regular basis (KattenFlex).
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include, but may not be limited to, the following. Other duties may be requested and/or assigned. Regular and predictable attendance is an essential function of the position. Essential functions are primary job duties that an individual must be able to perform successfully with or without a reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.Configure and maintain the Salesforce platform, including core object and field setup, validation rules, page layouts, user permissions, and supported third-party integrations.Create and maintain screen flows and process automations that streamline data entry, approvals, and repetitive user tasks.Work closely with the Marketing team to design and maintain reports and dashboards that give attorneys, business professionals, and Firm leadership visibility into pipeline, activity, and client relationships.Ensure data integrity through regular audits and consistent data hygiene standards across the Firm.Partner with stakeholders across the Firm to gather requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions that users will adopt.Champion CRM best practices Firmwide, reinforcing consistent data entry habits and effective use of platform functionality.Support attorney and staff users with Salesforce onboarding and manage upkeep of written and video training materials.Stay current on Salesforce releases and evaluate new features and AppExchange tools relevant to a professional services environment.
Knowledge, Skills and AbilitiesBachelor’s degree and three or more years of experience as a Salesforce Administrator or Salesforce Consultant. Experience in a law firm, consulting, or professional services environment preferred. Salesforce Administrator certificate required.Hands-on experience with a marketing automation or email marketing platform such as Vuture, Marketing Cloud, Pardot, or HubSpot, including building and deploying campaigns, managing audience segmentation, building forms and landing pages, and interpreting engagement metrics to improve performance.Direct experience building process automation with Salesforce Flow, including proactively identifying opportunities to reduce manual effort in cross-functional workflows.Experience leveraging AI tools and technology to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of operations and processes.Demonstrated experience leading or executing data quality initiatives, with the ability to speak to a specific project where data integrity was improved, deduplication or standardization logic was built, or governance standards were established, including the measurable impact.Strong analytical, critical thinking, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to assess ambiguous problems, recommend practical solutions, and communicate them clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.Dependable team player who works collaboratively and cooperatively with others in a team-oriented environment. Ability to act independently and make decisions within scope of the position’s responsibilities.
In our DC office, the annualized salary range for this position is $90,000 to $105,000. Actual pay will be adjusted based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law.
We offer an outstanding benefit package which includes: medical/dental/vision, 401k with employer contribution, parental leave, transportation fringe benefit program, back-up care option, generous paid time off policy and long-term and short-term disability policies.
Katten Muchin Rosenman LLP in an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

rows.descriptionText:
Please note that this is a contract role providing services to Hilton through Talent Solutions. If you are selected for this role, you will be employed by Talent Solutions and will not be an employee of Hilton. Contract workers are not employees of Hilton or any of its subsidiaries, nor will they be eligible for Hilton benefits.

Onsite role at our McLean, VA location. Contract through December 2026***

Job Summary

This position offers an exciting opportunity to shape how globally recognized hospitality brands connect with audiences across social media platforms. Working within the Global Marketing and Loyalty team, you will play a critical role in executing and evolving brand social strategies that drive meaningful business results. This role is ideal for a social media professional with hands-on experience who is ready to take on increasing responsibility while building strategic expertise. You will own day-to-day execution of brand social channels, translate performance insights into actionable recommendations, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure content aligns with brand priorities and cultural trends. Success in this role requires a balance of independent ownership, strategic thinking, and strong collaboration skills.

Responsibilities

 Own day-to-day execution of assigned brand social channels, including maintaining and executing against editorial calendars while proactively managing timelines, accuracy, and quality Define and execute social content aligned to brand and business priorities, contributing to content briefs for internal and external partners and optimizing existing creative resources Create low-lift assets as needed, including platform-native copy and light design updates Manage community engagement across multiple brand channels, applying sound judgment to foster positive interactions, escalate issues appropriately, and protect brand reputation Independently pull and interpret monthly performance data and reporting to identify trends, insights, and opportunities Translate learnings into actionable recommendations for future content and optimizations Monitor platforms and social listening tools to identify emerging trends, cultural moments, and audience sentiment that can inform real-time or near-term social strategy Collaborate cross-functionally with brand marketing, internal partners, and agency teams, building strong working relationships through clear communication, responsiveness, and informed recommendations Balance independent work with strong teamwork, moving projects forward proactively while ensuring alignment with broader social and brand strategies

Skills

 Passion for social media strategy and staying current on emerging platforms, features, and best practices Strong writing and communication skills with the ability to adapt tone and messaging across brands Ability to clearly articulate social recommendations to stakeholders Ownership and accountability with the ability to manage workstreams end-to-end Experience interpreting performance data and applying insights to inform content planning and recommendations Confidence managing multiple stakeholders and navigating feedback with professionalism High attention to detail and strong organizational skills Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional partners

Qualifications

 2+ years of professional experience supporting social media strategy and execution 1+ years of experience in an agency or fast-paced marketing environment Hands-on experience supporting or managing brand social media accounts on Facebook, Instagram, X, and Threads Experience reporting on social performance and applying insights to recommendations Experience with written and verbal collaboration with internal stakeholders and external agency partners Willingness to travel up to 10 percent and work occasional hours outside standard business hours Experience with social media management and planning tools preferred Familiarity with social publishing, listening, and analytics platforms preferred Experience using lightweight design tools to adapt and optimize creative preferred

This is an exceptional opportunity to contribute to the social media presence of world-class hospitality brands while developing your strategic expertise in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. You will have the chance to make a tangible impact on how beloved brands engage with audiences, while working alongside talented marketing professionals who are dedicated to innovation and excellence. If you are passionate about social media, thrive on data-driven decision making, and are ready to take ownership of meaningful work that shapes brand perception, this role offers the perfect platform to grow your career.

Pay Rate Range

25 - 29 USD hourly

rows.title: Platform Enablement Architect – Government ERP Solutions
rows.descriptionText:
Position Description

We are seeking an experienced Platform Enablement Architect to serve as the primary customer facing technical representative for our Government ERP platform. This role bridges Product Management, Cloud Operations, Security, Integrations, Customer Support, and Professional Services, providing customers and prospects with a consistent and trusted source of information regarding the technology, architecture, operations, and evolution of our Government ERP solution. Unlike a traditional Solution Architect role focused primarily on implementation design, this position is responsible for representing the broader platform strategy and communicating the value of our SaaS offering, security framework, integration capabilities, support model, operational processes, and technology roadmap to executive and technical audiences.

The successful candidate will possess a unique combination of technical credibility, executive presence, communication skills, and business acumen. Candidate must be equally comfortable facilitating executive briefings, leading customer workshops, conducting architecture discussions, and translating complex technical concepts into meaningful business outcomes. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor throughout the customer lifecycle, helping government organizations understand how the platform delivers value while reducing reliance on individual subject matter experts during routine customer and prospect engagements.

Location: This role can be performed from any of the US CGI office. Candidates should be able to work Eastern Time hours and follow a hybrid schedule of 2–3 days onsite per week.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Platform Representation & Technical Advisory

 Serve as the primary customer facing technical representative for the Platform Enablement organization. Act as a trusted advisor to government executives, CIOs, enterprise architects, IT leaders, and business stakeholders. Develop and deliver consistent technical messaging regarding platform capabilities, SaaS operations, cloud architecture, security, integrations, support services, and product roadmap. Lead executive briefings, customer workshops, architecture discussions, technology reviews, and strategic presentations. Represent the platform during sales pursuits, client engagements, conferences, industry events, and executive forums. Facilitate productive discussions between customers and internal subject matter experts while ensuring consistency of messaging and customer experience. Translate complex technical concepts into business focused outcomes and value propositions. Build and maintain trusted relationships with customer stakeholders throughout the sales, implementation, and operational lifecycle.

SaaS Platform & Operational Enablement

 Serve as a subject matter expert on the organization's SaaS delivery model, cloud infrastructure, support framework, and operational processes. Communicate platform scalability, availability, disaster recovery, business continuity, and service management capabilities to customers and prospects. Explain service level commitments, incident management processes, escalation procedures, release management practices, and customer support models. Support customer discussions regarding cloud adoption, modernization, operational readiness, and platform governance.

Security, Compliance & Integration Advisory

 Represent the platform's security architecture, compliance posture, privacy controls, and governance framework. Support customer security reviews, architecture assessments, and technical due diligence activities. Communicate integration strategies, API capabilities, interoperability approaches, and data management considerations. Collaborate with Security, Integration, and Cloud Operations teams to ensure customer facing materials accurately reflect platform capabilities and standards.

Customer Enablement & Thought Leadership

 Develop reusable customer facing materials, presentations, architecture narratives, FAQs, reference architectures, and technical positioning assets. Contribute to industry thought leadership and platform awareness through presentations, webinars, conferences, and customer forums. Identify recurring customer concerns and provide feedback to Product and Platform leadership regarding opportunities for improvement. Help establish consistent customer engagement practices and reduce dependency on individual SMEs during routine customer interactions.

Internal Collaboration

 Partner closely with Product Management, Cloud Operations, Security, Integrations, Support, and Professional Services teams. Ensure consistent messaging across all customer facing functions. Support RFPs, RFIs, proposals, and strategic business development activities. Mentor internal teams on platform capabilities, customer communication strategies, and industry trends.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, Public Administration, or a related field. 8+ years of experience in enterprise software, ERP solutions, SaaS platforms, cloud technologies, solution consulting, technical advisory, architecture, product management, or related customer facing technology roles. Experience working with government or public sector organizations. Strong understanding of SaaS operating models, cloud technologies, enterprise software platforms, and modern service delivery practices. Familiarity with ERP solutions supporting finance, procurement, budgeting, human resources, payroll, or asset management functions. Knowledge of enterprise integration approaches, APIs, and modern application architectures. Experience supporting complex customer engagements, technology discussions, and strategic sales pursuits.

Communication & Leadership Qualifications

 Demonstrated experience presenting to executive audiences, including CIOs, CTOs, CFOs, Deputy Ministers, Assistant Deputy Ministers, and senior government leaders. Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills. Proven ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non technical audiences. Experience leading executive briefings, customer workshops, technology reviews, and strategic planning sessions. Strong executive presence with the ability to establish credibility and trust quickly. Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority. Experience developing customer facing technical messaging, presentations, and thought leadership content.

________________________________________

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience with government ERP platforms such as CGI Advantage, Oracle, SAP, Workday, Unit4, Infor, or similar enterprise solutions. Experience with public sector digital transformation initiatives. Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Familiarity with government security, privacy, and compliance requirements. Experience participating in large scale SaaS transformations or cloud modernization programs. Certifications in enterprise architecture, cloud technologies, security, project management, or related disciplines are considered assets but are not required.

Success Measures

Within the first 12 months, the successful candidate will:

 Become the recognized technical advisor for Government ERP platform discussions. Successfully lead executive briefings, customer workshops, and strategic technology presentations across major client engagements. Establish trusted advisor relationships with key customer technology and business leaders. Improve consistency and quality of customer facing technical messaging across Product, Operations, Security, Integrations, and Support. Reduce dependency on individual subject matter experts for routine customer technology discussions. Increase customer confidence in the platform's SaaS operating model, support framework, security posture, and roadmap direction. Contribute to improved sales outcomes, customer satisfaction, and platform adoption through effective customer engagement. Develop reusable technical assets and enablement materials that support scalable customer interactions across the organization.

Other Information:

CGI is required by law in some jurisdictions to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. The determination of this range includes various factors not limited to skill set, level, experience, relevant training, and licensure and certifications. To support the ability to reward for merit based performance, CGI typically does not hire individuals at or near the top of the range for their role. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range for this role in the U.S. is $113,400.00 $198,400.00.

CGI's benefits are offered to eligible professionals on their first day of employment to include:

 Competitive compensation Comprehensive insurance options Matching contributions through the 401(k) plan and the share purchase plan Paid time off for vacation, holidays, and sick time Paid parental leave Learning opportunities and tuition assistance Wellness and well-being programs

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

The application window is expected to close on: 07/31/2026

Meet the Team

Splunk, a Cisco company, is building a safer, more resilient digital world with an end‑to‑end, full‑stack platform designed for hybrid, multi‑cloud environments. Join the Foundational Modeling team at Splunk, where we advance the state of AI for high‑volume, real‑time, multi‑modal machine‑generated data — including logs, time series, traces, and events! We combine deep AI research expertise with the scale and operational excellence of Splunk and Cisco’s global engineering capabilities. Our work spans networking, security, observability, and customer experience — designing and deploying foundation models that enhance reliability, strengthen security, prevent downtime, and deliver predictive insights across Splunk Observability, Security, and Platform at enterprise scale. You’ll be part of a culture that values technical excellence, impact‑driven innovation, and cross‑functional collaboration — all within a flexible, growth‑oriented environment!

Your Impact

Contribute to the research, design, and development of large-scale foundation models for machine-generated data, with a primary focus on graph data and additional support for logs, time series, traces, and event modalities. Develop and enhance distributed training and inference workflows, leveraging data-driven approaches to improve model quality, scalability, and operational efficiency. Collaborate with engineering, product, and data science teams to understand requirements, incorporate stakeholder feedback, and deliver AI/ML solutions that address business and technical needs. Share emerging ideas, technical insights, and best practices with teammates, contributing to technical discussions and helping advance team capabilities and project outcomes. Explore and evaluate new AI/ML techniques, tools, and methodologies, applying relevant innovations to improve workflows, solve technical challenges, and support the team’s roadmap and objectives. Take ownership of assigned projects and deliver high-quality results with urgency, while proactively identifying obstacles, driving resolution of technical issues, and continuously improving development processes. 

Minimum Qualifications

Master Degree in Computer Science, or related quantitative field, plus 2+ years of industry research experience. 1+ year of experience in at least one of the following areas: Large-scale graph representation learning and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) (e.g., GCN/GAT/GraphSAGE, heterogeneous GNNs, graph transformers), large language modeling for structured and unstructured data, multi-modal fusion of graph, text, log, and time-series data. 2+ years of experience in Python and deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) 1+ year experience translating research ideas into production systems. 

Preferred Qualifications

Deep experience with graph representation learning, graph transformers (e.g., GCN/GAT/GraphSAGE), spatio-temporal GNNs, heterogeneous graphs (HGNN/Relational GNNs), and knowledge-graph-augmented modeling. Expertise in constructing and operating on large-scale graphs (entity graphs, service dependency graphs, topology graphs, causal graphs, or log-event graphs). Hands-on experience with frameworks such as PyTorch Geometric (PyG), DGL, GraphGym, GraphML systems, or custom GNN runtimes. Advanced Anomaly Detection with Graph: Track record developing hybrid graph-temporal approaches (e.g., GNN + Transformer, graph contrastive learning, dynamic graph forecasting) for detecting anomalies in high-volume operational data.Hands-on experience developing, fine-tuning, or adapting foundation models for domain-specific data such as logs, time-series, graphs, operational telemetry, or enterprise knowledge, including representation learning across structured and unstructured modalities. Large‑Scale Training & Optimization – Experience optimizing model architectures, distributed training pipelines, and inference efficiency to minimize cost and latency while preserving accuracy. MLOps & Continuous Learning – Fluency in automated retraining, drift detection, incremental updates, and production monitoring of ML models. Strong Research Track Record – Publications in top AI/ML conferences or journals (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, CVPR, ACL, KDD) demonstrating contributions to state‑of‑the‑art methods and real‑world applications. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

rows.descriptionText:
Position Description

We are seeking an experienced Platform Enablement Architect to serve as the primary customer facing technical representative for our Government ERP platform. This role bridges Product Management, Cloud Operations, Security, Integrations, Customer Support, and Professional Services, providing customers and prospects with a consistent and trusted source of information regarding the technology, architecture, operations, and evolution of our Government ERP solution. Unlike a traditional Solution Architect role focused primarily on implementation design, this position is responsible for representing the broader platform strategy and communicating the value of our SaaS offering, security framework, integration capabilities, support model, operational processes, and technology roadmap to executive and technical audiences.

The successful candidate will possess a unique combination of technical credibility, executive presence, communication skills, and business acumen. Candidate must be equally comfortable facilitating executive briefings, leading customer workshops, conducting architecture discussions, and translating complex technical concepts into meaningful business outcomes. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor throughout the customer lifecycle, helping government organizations understand how the platform delivers value while reducing reliance on individual subject matter experts during routine customer and prospect engagements.

Location: This role can be performed from any of the US CGI office. Candidates should be able to work Eastern Time hours and follow a hybrid schedule of 2–3 days onsite per week.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Platform Representation & Technical Advisory

 Serve as the primary customer facing technical representative for the Platform Enablement organization. Act as a trusted advisor to government executives, CIOs, enterprise architects, IT leaders, and business stakeholders. Develop and deliver consistent technical messaging regarding platform capabilities, SaaS operations, cloud architecture, security, integrations, support services, and product roadmap. Lead executive briefings, customer workshops, architecture discussions, technology reviews, and strategic presentations. Represent the platform during sales pursuits, client engagements, conferences, industry events, and executive forums. Facilitate productive discussions between customers and internal subject matter experts while ensuring consistency of messaging and customer experience. Translate complex technical concepts into business focused outcomes and value propositions. Build and maintain trusted relationships with customer stakeholders throughout the sales, implementation, and operational lifecycle.

SaaS Platform & Operational Enablement

 Serve as a subject matter expert on the organization's SaaS delivery model, cloud infrastructure, support framework, and operational processes. Communicate platform scalability, availability, disaster recovery, business continuity, and service management capabilities to customers and prospects. Explain service level commitments, incident management processes, escalation procedures, release management practices, and customer support models. Support customer discussions regarding cloud adoption, modernization, operational readiness, and platform governance.

Security, Compliance & Integration Advisory

 Represent the platform's security architecture, compliance posture, privacy controls, and governance framework. Support customer security reviews, architecture assessments, and technical due diligence activities. Communicate integration strategies, API capabilities, interoperability approaches, and data management considerations. Collaborate with Security, Integration, and Cloud Operations teams to ensure customer facing materials accurately reflect platform capabilities and standards.

Customer Enablement & Thought Leadership

 Develop reusable customer facing materials, presentations, architecture narratives, FAQs, reference architectures, and technical positioning assets. Contribute to industry thought leadership and platform awareness through presentations, webinars, conferences, and customer forums. Identify recurring customer concerns and provide feedback to Product and Platform leadership regarding opportunities for improvement. Help establish consistent customer engagement practices and reduce dependency on individual SMEs during routine customer interactions.

Internal Collaboration

 Partner closely with Product Management, Cloud Operations, Security, Integrations, Support, and Professional Services teams. Ensure consistent messaging across all customer facing functions. Support RFPs, RFIs, proposals, and strategic business development activities. Mentor internal teams on platform capabilities, customer communication strategies, and industry trends.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, Public Administration, or a related field. 8+ years of experience in enterprise software, ERP solutions, SaaS platforms, cloud technologies, solution consulting, technical advisory, architecture, product management, or related customer facing technology roles. Experience working with government or public sector organizations. Strong understanding of SaaS operating models, cloud technologies, enterprise software platforms, and modern service delivery practices. Familiarity with ERP solutions supporting finance, procurement, budgeting, human resources, payroll, or asset management functions. Knowledge of enterprise integration approaches, APIs, and modern application architectures. Experience supporting complex customer engagements, technology discussions, and strategic sales pursuits.

Communication & Leadership Qualifications

 Demonstrated experience presenting to executive audiences, including CIOs, CTOs, CFOs, Deputy Ministers, Assistant Deputy Ministers, and senior government leaders. Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills. Proven ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non technical audiences. Experience leading executive briefings, customer workshops, technology reviews, and strategic planning sessions. Strong executive presence with the ability to establish credibility and trust quickly. Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority. Experience developing customer facing technical messaging, presentations, and thought leadership content.

________________________________________

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience with government ERP platforms such as CGI Advantage, Oracle, SAP, Workday, Unit4, Infor, or similar enterprise solutions. Experience with public sector digital transformation initiatives. Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Familiarity with government security, privacy, and compliance requirements. Experience participating in large scale SaaS transformations or cloud modernization programs. Certifications in enterprise architecture, cloud technologies, security, project management, or related disciplines are considered assets but are not required.

Success Measures

Within the first 12 months, the successful candidate will:

 Become the recognized technical advisor for Government ERP platform discussions. Successfully lead executive briefings, customer workshops, and strategic technology presentations across major client engagements. Establish trusted advisor relationships with key customer technology and business leaders. Improve consistency and quality of customer facing technical messaging across Product, Operations, Security, Integrations, and Support. Reduce dependency on individual subject matter experts for routine customer technology discussions. Increase customer confidence in the platform's SaaS operating model, support framework, security posture, and roadmap direction. Contribute to improved sales outcomes, customer satisfaction, and platform adoption through effective customer engagement. Develop reusable technical assets and enablement materials that support scalable customer interactions across the organization.

rows.title: Social Media Analyst (contract)
rows.descriptionText:
Please note that this is a contract role providing services to Hilton through Talent Solutions. If you are selected for this role, you will be employed by Talent Solutions and will not be an employee of Hilton. Contract workers are not employees of Hilton or any of its subsidiaries, nor will they be eligible for Hilton benefits.

Onsite role at our McLean, VA location. Contract through December 2026***

Job Summary

This position offers an exciting opportunity to shape how globally recognized hospitality brands connect with audiences across social media platforms. Working within the Global Marketing and Loyalty team, you will play a critical role in executing and evolving brand social strategies that drive meaningful business results. This role is ideal for a social media professional with hands-on experience who is ready to take on increasing responsibility while building strategic expertise. You will own day-to-day execution of brand social channels, translate performance insights into actionable recommendations, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure content aligns with brand priorities and cultural trends. Success in this role requires a balance of independent ownership, strategic thinking, and strong collaboration skills.

Responsibilities

 Own day-to-day execution of assigned brand social channels, including maintaining and executing against editorial calendars while proactively managing timelines, accuracy, and quality Define and execute social content aligned to brand and business priorities, contributing to content briefs for internal and external partners and optimizing existing creative resources Create low-lift assets as needed, including platform-native copy and light design updates Manage community engagement across multiple brand channels, applying sound judgment to foster positive interactions, escalate issues appropriately, and protect brand reputation Independently pull and interpret monthly performance data and reporting to identify trends, insights, and opportunities Translate learnings into actionable recommendations for future content and optimizations Monitor platforms and social listening tools to identify emerging trends, cultural moments, and audience sentiment that can inform real-time or near-term social strategy Collaborate cross-functionally with brand marketing, internal partners, and agency teams, building strong working relationships through clear communication, responsiveness, and informed recommendations Balance independent work with strong teamwork, moving projects forward proactively while ensuring alignment with broader social and brand strategies

Skills

 Passion for social media strategy and staying current on emerging platforms, features, and best practices Strong writing and communication skills with the ability to adapt tone and messaging across brands Ability to clearly articulate social recommendations to stakeholders Ownership and accountability with the ability to manage workstreams end-to-end Experience interpreting performance data and applying insights to inform content planning and recommendations Confidence managing multiple stakeholders and navigating feedback with professionalism High attention to detail and strong organizational skills Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional partners

Qualifications

 2+ years of professional experience supporting social media strategy and execution 1+ years of experience in an agency or fast-paced marketing environment Hands-on experience supporting or managing brand social media accounts on Facebook, Instagram, X, and Threads Experience reporting on social performance and applying insights to recommendations Experience with written and verbal collaboration with internal stakeholders and external agency partners Willingness to travel up to 10 percent and work occasional hours outside standard business hours Experience with social media management and planning tools preferred Familiarity with social publishing, listening, and analytics platforms preferred Experience using lightweight design tools to adapt and optimize creative preferred

This is an exceptional opportunity to contribute to the social media presence of world-class hospitality brands while developing your strategic expertise in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. You will have the chance to make a tangible impact on how beloved brands engage with audiences, while working alongside talented marketing professionals who are dedicated to innovation and excellence. If you are passionate about social media, thrive on data-driven decision making, and are ready to take ownership of meaningful work that shapes brand perception, this role offers the perfect platform to grow your career.

Pay Rate Range

25 - 29 USD hourly

 Analyze client business processes to identify optimization opportunities and align them with industry-specific standards and best practices Facilitate benchmarking studies, working with stakeholders to align solution performance with industry standards and domain-specific insights Collaborate with technical teams and document system customizations and configurations, drafting standard operating procedures and workflows that align with functional requirements of the relevant sector Conduct in-depth research on third-party products within the domain, providing comparative analysis of features, costs, and scalability Coordinate the implementation of solutions addressing issues during setup and integration, and support in developing and maintaining SOPs, to ensure system stability and performance post-implementation

Your Contribution To The Team

 A collaborative spirit and excellent communication skills. Strong analytical and coordination skills with a focus on process optimization A knack for creating detailed process maps and technical documentation with domain specialization Proactive approach to in conducting benchmarking studies and product research Familiarity with system implementation, configuration, and maintenance Effective collaboration and communication abilities with cross-functional teams

Required Skill And Experience

 Experience in Deposits/Lending/online banking or Customer onboarding/KYC process Experience in business analysis by gathering detailed requirements and translating them into actionable technical scope and objectives Experience in creating conceptual designs and secure alignment with business and technology stakeholders, including maintenance intakes

Preferred Skill And Experience

 Experience working cross-functionally with Risk, Finance, Business and Tech teams, particularly on Consent Order and regulatory initiatives Experience in performing data flow research and analyze data sources to design data mapping and transformation solutions.

This position may require relocation and/or travel to work/project location. Candidates authorized to work for any employer in the United States without employer-based visa sponsorship are welcome to apply. Infosys is unable to provide immigration sponsorship for this role now or in the future.

Benefits

Medical/Dental/Vision/Life InsuranceLong-term/Short-term DisabilityHealth and Dependent Care Reimbursement AccountsInsurance (Accident, Critical Illness , Hospital Indemnity, Legal)401(k) plan and contributions dependent on salary levelPaid holidays plus Paid Time Off

Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in more than 50 countries to navigate their digital transformation. rows.title: Analyst, Commercial Strategy & Operations (Johns Hopkins Technology Ventures)
rows.descriptionText:
Johns Hopkins Technology Ventures (JHTV), the university's technology commercialization division, is launching the JHTV Analyst Program, a structured two-year experiential learning opportunity designed for recent graduates interested in innovation, entrepreneurship, healthcare, science, business, law, technology, and public impact.

We are seeking an Analyst, Commercial Strategy & Operations who will contribute to high-priority strategic initiatives while gaining broad exposure to technology commercialization, startup formation, intellectual property, corporate engagement, venture funding, and innovation management. Through cohort-based learning, professional development programming, executive exposure, cross-functional projects, and mentorship, analysts develop the analytical, communication, and leadership skills that prepare them for graduate study or future careers across the innovation economy.

At the end of the two-year term, Analysts may be considered for open positions within JHTV or the university; however, continuation of employment beyond the term is not guaranteed.

The Analyst, Commercial Strategy & Operations supports university-wide efforts to expand industry engagement, strengthen external partnerships, and advance commercialization opportunities. The role combines research, strategy, operations, communications, and business analysis to support leadership decision-making and organizational growth.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to support strategic initiatives and organizational priorities.Collect, organize, analyze, and synthesize information from multiple sources to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and recommendations.Develop reports, dashboards, presentations, briefing materials, and executive summaries for operational and strategic decision-making.Support projects involving faculty, university leaders, external partners, and other stakeholders by conducting research, analysis, and developing recommendations.Translate complex information into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences.Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining a high level of accuracy and professionalism.Support business process improvement initiatives and recommend enhancements to tools, systems, workflows, and reporting practices.Maintain accurate records, documentation, trackers, and project materials.Build productive relationships across JHTV and the broader university community.Present findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and leadership.Participate in cohort-based onboarding, professional development programming, mentorship opportunities, and cross-functional learning experiences.Contribute to a capstone project and final presentation addressing a strategic opportunity or challenge within JHTV.Support special projects and other duties as assigned.

In addition to duties described above

Research the Hopkins campus landscape, peer institutions, and emerging models in commercial revenue, technology transfer, and university-industry partnerships.Collect, clean, and consolidate data from disparate sources into usable datasets and KPI dashboards.Build and maintain KPI dashboards and recurring leadership reports, with regular updates and refinements as priorities evolve.Identify trends, opportunities, and notable changes in data to support leadership reporting and decision-making.Develop one-pagers, briefing memos, presentations, decks, talking points, and other materials for board meetings, dean briefings, corporate partner conversations, and leadership communications.Maintain consistent formatting, branding, and quality standards across all materials produced by the function.Provide ad hoc research, analysis, and project support for strategic initiatives and priorities led by senior leadership.Maintain organized records, trackers, reporting tools, and documentation supporting the team's pipeline and reporting needs.Identify opportunities to improve or streamline existing tools, templates, processes, and reporting practices.Support preparation for meetings and engagements involving corporate partners, industry stakeholders, university leadership, and advisory groups.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in a related field.No prior professional experience required.Additional education may substitute for required experience, and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.

Preferred Qualifications

U.S. Citizen or Legal Permanent Resident required due to Federal Export Controls.Advanced Degree in a related field.Three years of related experience.Strong communication, presentation, and executive writing skills.Experience conducting research and developing recommendations from complex information.Comfort working with data and performance metrics.Interest in business development, strategic planning, consulting, higher education, or technology commercialization.Ability to work effectively in ambiguous and fast-changing environments.Full-time, in-person role based in Baltimore, MD.Fast-paced environment with variable hours; not a fixed 9-to-5 schedule.

Technical Skills & Expected Level Of Proficiency

Data Management and Analysis - DevelopingBusiness Process Analysis - DevelopingReport Writing - DevelopingPresentations - DevelopingProject Management - DevelopingStakeholder Engagement - DevelopingChange Management - Developing

The core technical skills listed are most essential; additional technical skills may be required based on specific division or department needs.

rows.title: Junior Financial Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: Junior Financial Analyst

Job Description

The Analyst processes complex transactions and reconciliations related to loan and security payments, with a strong focus on pooled loan data and mortgage-backed securities. This role combines data entry, accounting, and detailed financial analysis to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting for collateral, securities, default, and trust administration activities. The position offers growth opportunities, exposure to multiple financial systems, and the chance to contribute to process improvements in a highly collaborative, deadline-driven environment.

Responsibilities

Process the most complex transactions and reconciliations related to loan and security payments with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.Perform data entry, accounting, and analysis of pooled loan data from multiple mortgage servicers to identify and resolve variances.Use multiple database systems and Microsoft Excel to compare, validate, and reconcile data across various sources.Provide remittance and correction information to servicers to ensure accurate payment processing and reporting.Monitor and analyze pooled loans to identify non-compliance and communicate relevant findings to investors.Evaluate servicer performance to ensure compliance with stated agreements and document any exceptions or issues.Research and interpret controlling legal documents when issues arise related to collateral or bond payments.Maintain a working knowledge of collateral, securities, default, and trust administration practices and requirements.Participate in system enhancements by attending user groups, performing testing, and offering feedback on functionality.Identify, document, and communicate processing exceptions that are relevant to similar series across individual portfolios.Review and validate junior staff processing and reconciliations to ensure quality and adherence to procedures.Train junior level staff as needed, sharing best practices and supporting their development.Propose recommendations for process improvements and implement automated solutions on an ongoing basis to enhance efficiency.Meet strict monthly deadlines for analyses and reporting, including working overtime when necessary to complete required tasks.Collaborate closely with team members in a task-based environment to prioritize work and achieve shared goals.

Essential Skills

Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and other advanced functions.Ability to perform detailed financial analysis on pooled loan data and mortgage-related information.Solid understanding of business analysis concepts and techniques applied to financial services data.Competence in accounting principles related to loan and security payment processing and reconciliations.Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to work comfortably with complex data and math.Ability to research and interpret legal and financial documents, particularly those related to collateral and bond payments.Capacity to maintain a working knowledge of collateral, securities, default, and trust administration.Attention to detail and accuracy in data entry, reconciliation, and documentation.Effective written and verbal communication skills to interact with servicers, investors, and internal stakeholders.Ability to work in a deadline-driven environment and manage multiple tasks to meet monthly reporting timelines.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Math, Economics, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Business, or a related field.Preferred 1+ year of experience in financial services, including internship experience.Experience working with multiple database systems in a financial or analytical setting.Demonstrated ability to evaluate performance against contractual agreements and compliance standards.Experience participating in system enhancement initiatives, including user group involvement and testing.Background in proposing and implementing automated solutions or process improvements.Comfort working with pooled loans, mortgage servicing data, and structured finance products.Strong teamwork skills with the ability to collaborate in a task-based, team-oriented environment.Motivation to pursue growth opportunities and advancement within an organization.

Work Environment

The role operates in a highly team-oriented, task-based environment where collaboration and shared problem-solving are central to success. The work is deadline-driven, with key analyses and reconciliations required at specific points during the month, which may necessitate overtime to ensure all obligations are met. The position offers a hybrid and flexible schedule, with some training conducted on-site and large team meetings held monthly on-site in a designated office location. Outside of major conferences or team meetings, there is remote flexibility, allowing for a blend of in-office and remote work. The culture emphasizes growth opportunities, continuous learning, and participation in system enhancements, creating an environment that supports professional development and advancement.

Job Type & Location

This is a Contract position based out of Columbia, MD.

Pay And Benefits

The pay range for this position is $23.00 - $23.00/hr.

Individual compensation offered for this position within this range will depend on many factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, job knowledge, geographic location, internal equity, and other pertinent job-related factors.

Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. rows.title: Project Finance Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
COMPANY OVERVIEWCORE POWER was founded in 2018 to solve the world's energy challenges by delivering ship-based power directly to the industries and economies driving global prosperity, overcoming the barriers that have held nuclear energy back.
CORE POWER builds, integrates and deploys ship-based nuclear energy systems. We build and support two classes of vessel: moored ship-shaped power plants that generate high-density energy, and nuclear-powered commercial ships that will speed up global trade.
Headquartered in Chiswick, London, with offices in Washington, D.C. and Japan, CORE POWER operates at the intersection of advanced nuclear, maritime, energy security and industrial policy.
Role SummaryThe Project Finance Analyst joins the Commercial Analytics team with a focus on the project financing and deal economics of floating nuclear power plants (FNPP) and commercial marine nuclear propulsion (CMNP). The role develops, builds and maintains the project finance models that define the economics of selling and deploying an FNPP/CMNP, covering SPV structures, offtake and PPA pricing, cash flows and project returns, and provides the economic analysis and costing support that feeds delivery programs, including reactor and end user partnerships. The role also supports the evaluation of capital formation options for first-of-a-kind energy infrastructure, spanning equity, debt, export credit and government-backed financing, and the assessment of deployment opportunities for commercial and financial viability. As a pre-revenue, first-of-a-kind business, this analysis directly informs pricing, commercialization strategy, business model development and investor engagement.
Key ResponsibilitiesProvides project finance modelling, deal economics and costing support across the Analytics portfolio, alongside broader economic assessment covering market and competitive cost positioning, policy and incentive impacts, and business model economics, always with a commercial focus. Works closely with the Director of Analytics, the Commercial team, program leads and external partners to ensure the economics of FNPP and CMNP deployment are rigorously modelled, transparently documented and ready for commercial and investor use.
Job RequirementsProject Finance Modelling & Deal Economics:Builds and maintains project finance models for FNPP and CMNP deployments, covering SPV structures, capital structure/stack and gearing, cash flow and project returns (IRR, NPV, DSCR, payback).Models offtake and revenue structures, including PPA pricing, tolling, charter style and lease versus own arrangements, and how deal economics differ across end users (utilities, data centers, industrial off-takers, shipowners).Develops financing scenarios and sensitivity analysis across cost of capital, contract tenor, delivery risk, refueling and refurbishment cycles, and residual value.Benchmarks structures, pricing and returns against comparable energy and infrastructure transactions and monitors relevant project finance market activity.Supports evaluation of capital formation and financing structures for first-of-a-kind deployment, including equity, debt, export credit agency and government-backed programs, and what each implies for project bankability.Maintains model documentation, assumption registers and audit trails to investment-grade standards, ensuring models are review-ready for external scrutiny.
Economic Analysis & Program Costing:Provides support to economic analysis and cost modelling feeding delivery programs, including reactor vendor and end user collaboration projects.Supports bottom-up cost model development (cost to deliver), lifecycle cost analysis and LCOE/TCO assessment, integrating engineering inputs and partner data.Independently tests and challenges external cost estimates from partners and vendors.Translates techno-economic outputs into commercial implications such as pricing floors, margin structure, breakeven and bankability.Conducts broader economic assessment with a commercial focus, including market and competitive cost positioning, policy and incentive impacts, and business model economics.
Commercial & Investor Support:Prepares deal economics and pricing analysis supporting commercial negotiations and business development activity.Supports development of analysis and materials underpinning investor engagement, including cost of product, unit economics and project returns cases.Coordinates with the Finance team to ensure project-level models align with corporate financial planning and fundraising materials.
Ways of Working:Applies the team’s model standards, version control and review processes, and contributes to the shared knowledge base.Supports the development of graduate analysts in project finance methods as the team grows.Operates effectively in a first-of-a-kind/novel environment: forms defensible assumptions where no precedent exists, documents them transparently, and revises them as evidence develops.
Experience & Qualifications3 - 5 years' experience in project finance gained at a bank, infrastructure fund, developer, utility or advisory firm, with energy or infrastructure project financing strongly preferred.Strong financial modelling capability, including project cash flow modelling and scenario analysis; advanced Excel essential, Python an advantage.Working knowledge of project finance structures and documentation, including SPVs, offtake contracts, security packages and lender requirements.Comfortable working across technical and engineering interfaces, and with the ambiguity inherent in a novel industry.
BenefitsCompetitive salary.Performance-based bonuses.Health and wellness benefits.Pension plan.Professional development opportunities.A highly committed, dynamic, and challenging environment.
If you are interested in joining CORE POWER, please submit your CV and a cover letter by the20th of September, outlining your experience and motivation to join our team!
